content: AMISY ararimbe weye Po wansapaya wama marova mai
Daud apa ransyerano Israel ukiny dai arono wanya usea no Yavar Amisy no Yerusalem.

content.text: Ranivara AMISY be marimbe wansai jewen datire?
Inya, vatano Israel, koveamo wapo raura taiso maisy:
Ranivara AMISY be marimbe wansai jewen datire?
Arono vatane usea ti umarovave wansai,
weamo wo wansaubaisy ti wene mo wansaunto jayaibe,
Weti wo wansao bintabo, maisyare manayame inta mo wansaugaveta wemaisy,
muno maisyare manayame nsepadi wansai wemaisy,
muno maisyare manayamo mpanyoane ama vambunine mo wansakupita wemaisy.
AMISY ararimbe, weye Opamo Po wansaunanto wama marova mai jewen,
onawamo maisyare make sivuiny ware wo wansarisyi wemaisy.
maisyare insanije upaya irati pamuno nsawa maije rai.
Pamuno wem mpatimu ti wampapaya rai to.
AMISY Wepirati Po naume muno mine so ranari,
Opirati Po wansapaya irati kakai rai.
